concepts.title: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
concepts.ncert_text: Every composite number can be expressed (factorised) as a product of primes, and this factorisation is unique, apart from the order in which the prime factors occur.

concepts.title: HCF and LCM Relation
concepts.ncert_text: For any two positive integers a and b, HCF(a, b) x LCM(a, b) = a x b.

concepts.title: Revisiting Irrational Numbers
concepts.ncert_text: A number 's' is called irrational if it cannot be written in the form p/q. If p is a prime and p divides a^2, then p divides a. This is used to prove √2, √3 are irrational.
